text:
Chloe Martin: heads up, marketplace onboarding work is getting close and we still need a few Console pieces nailed down for buyers. Specifically: org linking UI, entitlement state visibility, and better error messaging. Can we align on what ships in the first cut?

Ethan Park: +1. Control plane side is ingesting AWS/GCP entitlements, but if Console doesn’t show state clearly we’ll drown in support tickets. What do you need from us?

Chloe Martin: proposal for Console:
1) “Link marketplace purchase” entry point in Settings → Billing (and also a banner when we detect marketplace-origin traffic).
2) status card that shows:
- Provider (AWS/GCP)
- Entitlement: pending / active / suspended
- SKU name (human readable) + internal entitlement id (copy button)
- Region (purchased region vs org’s serving region)
- Last webhook received (timestamp)
3) a lightweight “link org” step that asks for the external account id (AWS payer account / GCP billing account) and confirms before binding.

Rafael Mendes: re: status card, can we also show “next retry” / “we’re still processing” copy for the delayed entitlement issue? SRE is adding lag metrics but the user needs to know it’s not stuck forever.

Chloe Martin: yep. We can show a “Processing entitlement (can take up to X minutes)” state when we have a purchase signal but no active entitlement yet.

Dev Patel: please include a “Contact support” link that pre-fills org id + provider + entitlement id. Today we keep asking customers for screenshots.

Leila Farouk: for QA, can we define the exact error states? I’ve got fixtures for:
- entitlement not found
- entitlement found but not mapped to plan
- region mismatch
- entitlement belongs to a different Redwood org (already linked)
- multiple entitlements (customer bought two SKUs)

Ethan Park: region mismatch is the big one. On backend we can mark entitlement as valid but “not deployable” if org’s default region doesn’t match marketplace region. We should avoid hard-blocking if their deployment is Hosted and multi-region is allowed.

Chloe Martin: agree. In UI I’d like to show “Entitlement active, but selected region doesn’t match purchase region” with a CTA:
- “Change org default region” (if they can)
- or “Contact support to enable additional regions” (if enterprise)

Elliot Price: + docs angle: we should keep Console wording aligned with docs FAQs. Avoid promising instant activation. Security also asked we don’t say “real-time” anywhere.

Rafael Mendes: also for incident response: if webhook ingestion is down, Console should show a distinct message vs generic “something went wrong”. Can we bubble up an error code?

Chloe Martin: I can add an error surface like:
- Title: “We couldn’t verify your marketplace entitlement”
- Body: short explanation + error code (e.g., `MP_ENTITLEMENT_LOOKUP_FAILED`)
- Actions: Retry, View troubleshooting, Contact support

Ethan Park: from control plane we can return typed errors:
- `ENTITLEMENT_PENDING`
- `ENTITLEMENT_NOT_FOUND`
- `ENTITLEMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`
- `ENTITLEMENT_ALREADY_LINKED`
- `ENTITLEMENT_REGION_MISMATCH`
- `ENTITLEMENT_SKU_UNMAPPED`
We’ll keep them stable for support macros.

Dev Patel: :thumbsup: if those map 1:1 to support macros, it’ll cut triage time.

Leila Farouk: question on “already linked”: what do we want UI to do? Hard stop with guidance? Or allow “request transfer”?

Chloe Martin: for v1, hard stop with a very clear path:
- “This purchase is already linked to a different Redwood org.”
- “If you need to move it, contact support with entitlement id.”
We shouldn’t implement self-serve transfer without guardrails.

Connor O'Brien: release coordination: we need this behind a flag for the first week of marketplace listing updates. Can Console gate the marketplace wizard by org feature flag?

Chloe Martin: yes, `marketplace_onboarding_v2` flag in Console, checked server-side. We can also allow per-org enablement so sales can pilot.

Rafael Mendes: can we log all wizard events to our audit trail? At least link attempts + success/fail + error code. Security asked for an audit trail for entitlement linking changes.

Ethan Park: backend already writes audit events for linking/unlinking, but not for failed attempts. We can add audit for failures with rate limiting so we don’t spam.

Chloe Martin: UI can log client-side “attempt” but I prefer server-side for anything security related. Ethan, can you add “link_attempt_failed” with error code?

Ethan Park: yep, I’ll add that to the API layer.

Leila Farouk: acceptance criteria I’m capturing:
- If entitlement is pending, user sees “Processing…” state + expected time window + retry
- If active, user sees SKU + provider + region + last event timestamp
- Errors render stable code + suggested action(s)
- All states work for AWS + GCP fixtures
- Feature-flagged per org
Anything missing?

Dev Patel: include a “Copy details” button that copies:
org_id, entitlement_id, provider, sku, region, error_code
This is huge for support.

Chloe Martin: adding.

Elliot Price: and please don’t show internal plan codes in UI. Keep it “Hosted API / Dedicated / Private” friendly naming. Internal ids only behind a copy action.

Chloe Martin: yep, human readable SKU name, internal id only via copy.

Rafael Mendes: last thing: show entitlement “last updated” and if it’s > 30 min old, suggest checking provider account / verifying they purchased the right listing.

Chloe Martin: I can add a subtle warning banner: “We haven’t received an update from AWS/GCP in 30+ minutes.” plus link to troubleshooting.

Ethan Park: cool. I’ll send over the error enum + payload shape today. We’re trying to keep it consistent with ENG-4401/4403.

Connor O'Brien: timeline wise, can we get this into next week’s canary so Partner team can screenshot the happy path?

Chloe Martin: if I get backend payload by EOD, I can land UI early next week. Screenshots need stable copy, so locking wording now would help.

Elliot Price: I’ll sync with Soojin/PMM on exact phrasing for the user-facing text (esp. activation time + region mismatch). I’ll drop final copy blocks here.

Dev Patel: thanks all. Once copy is set, I’ll update macros with the error codes.

Rafael Mendes: :eyes: please tag me when it’s in staging, I want to verify the “provider unavailable” path and make sure it correlates with the new dashboards.

Chloe Martin: will do. Action items:
- Ethan: send payload shape + implement audit for failed link attempts
- Elliot: finalize copy blocks (pending/region mismatch/already linked)
- Chloe: build Settings → Billing status card + linking wizard + copy details
- Leila: expand E2E to include region mismatch + already linked
- Dev: prep support macros keyed off error codes

Ethan Park: ack.

Connor O'Brien: ack, I’ll track this in release checklist.
